_comment: The Grade 2 English standalone lesson build - the SAME builder as Grade 1 (../grade-1-app/build-lessons.py --app .), pointed at english/grade-2/data by this file. Order here IS the unit number and the COURSE's unit number, as in Grade 1, so u01..u10 are unit completions. strandRoles says which of this grade's Core-words strands feeds which step: Grade 2's word list is authored as spelling / topic / joining / topic (two topic groups per unit), and the steps are named for what a child does - 'sounds' hears one spelling pattern, 'sight' knows the little words that join ideas, 'newwords' meets both topic groups merged.
